snippet.title: Aeterna: Curse of The First King - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4223830/Aeterna_Curse_of_The_First_King

The Roman Republic is on the brink of collapse. As ambition, betrayal, and ancient forces threaten to plunge the world into chaos, a darker fate begins to unfold.

Aeterna: Curse of The First King is a brutal isometric action RPG set in the final years of the Roman Republic, where history and mythology collide. Prepare for challenging combat, colossal enemies, and a journey into the shadows of an empire on the verge of its fall.

Your fate is written in blood. Will you defy it?
